export_windows.payouts.csv: arrival date >= 2026-07-01, created before the export moment
export_windows.invoices.csv: created from 2026-07-01 05:00:00 UTC to the export moment; status as of export
export_windows.subscriptions.csv: all subscriptions not ended before 2026-07-01 05:00:00 UTC; state as of export

definitions.month: UTC calendar month; an item belongs to the month of its balance-transaction created time (UTC).
definitions.money: USD, 2 decimals. Charges at the charge's own exchange rate; refunds, disputes and dispute reversals at the rate Stripe applied on the day of that event (what actually moved the balance).
definitions.gross_charges: Successful live charges/payments created in the month (reporting_category=charge).
definitions.refunds: Refunds created in the month minus refund failures that returned money in the month (categories refund + refund_failure), including refunds of earlier months' payments.
definitions.disputes_lost: Disputed amounts withdrawn from the balance in the month (category dispute, gross, without the $15 fee), whatever the later outcome. Inquiries withdraw nothing.
definitions.disputes_won_back: Disputed amounts returned in the month because a dispute was won (dispute_reversal gross).
definitions.tax_collected: Stripe Tax amounts contained in the month's successful charges, converted at the charge rate. Not reduced by refunds. Invoices paid entirely from customer credit are not included.
definitions.by_currency: Per presentment currency: successful charges in the month (count, gross in that currency, gross/fees in USD).
definitions.fees.processing: Sum of the fee column of the month's charge rows (2.9% + 30c, +1.5% non-US card, +1% currency conversion; ACH 0.8% capped at $5).
definitions.fees.dispute_fees_net: $15 per dispute withdrawal in the month minus $15 per won dispute returned in the month.
definitions.fees.other: reporting_category=fee rows created in the month (Billing and Tax usage fees, including a duplicate row later credited by an other_adjustment). The credit is NOT netted here.
definitions.payouts.paid: Payouts whose balance transaction was created in the month (funds left Stripe) and that did not fail, with their arrival date; may arrive next month (see in_transit).
definitions.payouts.failed: Payouts created in the month that failed; the money came back as payout_reversal.
definitions.balance: Stripe balance (available + pending, excluding reserved funds) = running sum of every balance transaction net. opening at 00:00:00 UTC on the 1st, closing at 00:00:00 UTC on the next 1st.
definitions.in_transit_at_month_end: Sum of payouts created before month end whose arrival_date is after month end.
definitions.reserve_held_closing: Funds held by the rolling reserve at month end (withheld minus released).
definitions.subscriptions.renewals_paid: subscription_cycle invoices that are not the first paid cycle after a trial, paid in the month (includes invoices paid late for an earlier period and invoices settled entirely from customer credit).
definitions.subscriptions.renewals_failed: Renewal invoices finalized in the month still not paid at month end (open/past due, or voided by the dunning cleanup).
definitions.subscriptions.new_paid: subscription_create invoices with a non-zero total paid in the month (no trial).
definitions.subscriptions.trials_converted: First subscription_cycle invoice after a trial, paid in the month.
definitions.subscriptions.mrr_closing: Active + past_due subscriptions at month end (not trialing/unpaid/canceled), monthly-normalised (annual/12), after repeating/forever coupons, excluding tax (inclusive EUR/GBP prices netted of VAT), converted at the last day's rate.
definitions.excluded.test_mode: Test-mode payment ids appended to the payments export; never in balance/payouts.
definitions.excluded.failed_payments: Live charge attempts that failed (no money moved).
definitions.excluded.refunded_later: Refund ids for this month's payments whose refund happened in a later month (they belong to the later month's refunds).
